title: stenaria nigricans
intro: Stenaria nigricans, commonly known as Black-eyed Susan or Mexican Hairgrass, is a perennial plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin diseases. The therapeutic actions of Stenaria nigricans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications of this plant.
